---
name: Design RFC
about: Propose a design change (UI, token, component, flow) for public review
title: "[RFC] "
labels: ["design", "rfc"]
---

## Problem
What user need or pain does this address? (One or two sentences.)

## User story
As a **<who>**, I want **<what>**, so that **<why>**.

## Proposal
The design change. Link wireframes, low-fi specs, or screenshots. Low fidelity is welcome — no need to commit to high-fidelity visual work before review.

## Tokens & components
Which tokens in `design/tokens.json` or components change? Any **new hue** — the palette is locked; a new hue requires strong justification and explicit approval.

## Honesty check
Does this introduce any fabricated state, arbitrary upload, or a "wired" claim that isn't true? (If yes, that's a blocker — see `CONTRIBUTING.md`.)

## Alternatives considered
What else was weighed, and why this?

## Open questions
What needs feedback before this is worth building?
